quote: Mankind was my business. The common welfare was my business; charity, mercy, forbearance, and benevolence, were, all, my business.
source: Charles Dickens, A Christmas Carol, Stave I, Marley’s Ghost (Chapman and Hall, 1843) (the Ghost of Jacob Marley)
speaker: the Ghost of Jacob Marley
